name: @aiti-ai/aiti-secret-vault
description: Encrypted secret vault management UI for pi-web: list / add / rotate / reveal / remove aliases, lock/unlock, switch between keyfile and OS-keychain unlock, and inspect which aliases are mounted per session. Values never enter the AI conversation.

descriptionI18n.zh-CN: pi-web 的加密密钥库管理弹窗——别名查看/新增/轮换/查看明文/删除、锁定/解锁、keyfile ↔ 系统钥匙串切换、会话挂载总览；值只走浏览器→本机服务→加密库，不经过 AI 对话
